title: Composite Pattern
description: Compose objects into tree structures to represent part-whole hierarchies.

data.text: The **Composite Pattern** composes objects into tree structures to represent part-whole hierarchies. It lets clients treat individual objects and compositions uniformly.

data.title: Composite Pattern
Key Takeaways
points: Treats individual and composite objects uniformly
Common in UI frameworks and file systems
data.takeaway: Use Composite Pattern when you need to represent hierarchies of objects.
